entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to start a return. Order number VF98765-4.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up for you... VF98765-4. I see the AeroShield helmet here. Can I ask what specifically is the issue with the item?
The color isn't what I expected. It doesn't match my bike. I haven't even taken it out of the packaging; the box unopened.
I see. So to be clear, is it a technical fault with the helmet or a preference regarding the color?
It's the color. As I said. Can I return it or not? It's a simple question.

Yes, absolutely. I see here you received it nine days ago, so you're well within our 90-day return window. I can definitely get that return started for you. All our helmets meet the highest safety standards, so I'm confident you'll be happy once we find you the right one.
Okay, good. What's the next step?

I've just approved the return in our system and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. Just print that out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
